title: Competition Payload (v1) — Reference-plane entity
description: Phase 13.2 — Competition record payload per COMPETITIONS.md §2.1. Describes the competition's format, scope, venue policy, and calibration profile. Used by Phase 16 emitter to serialize records with record_type='competition'.

competition_id.description: Canonical, globally unique identifier (lowercase alphanumeric + underscore).

format.description: Axis A — Competition format per COMPETITIONS.md §1.1. Determines calibration strategy.

scope.description: Axis B — Competition scope per COMPETITIONS.md §1.2 (league, cup, international, etc.).

default_venue_policy.description: Axis C — Default venue policy (may be overridden per stage).

organizer.description: Organization running the competition (TFF, UEFA, FIFA, RFEF, etc.).

confederation.description: Continental confederation or null for domestic competitions.

countries.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country codes. Single entry for domestic, multiple for continental.

nationality_restricted.description: True for international_* competitions; False for club competitions.

calibration_profile_id.description: Calibration profile ID (e.g., 'knockout_continental_club'). Determines predictor overlays.

stages.description: Stages for composite formats (group_then_knockout, multi_stage_qualifier). Null or empty for simple formats.

first_season.description: Year of first edition, or null if ongoing/new.

active.description: True if the competition is currently active (accepting fixtures).

successor_competition_id.description: If renamed/replaced, points to the new competition (e.g., UEFA Cup → UEFA Europa League).

CompetitionStage.description: A stage within a composite competition format.

format.description: Format of this stage (may differ from parent competition format).

legs.description: 1 for single-leg, 2 for two-leg (e.g., knockout rounds).

venue_policy.description: Venue policy for this stage (may override competition.default_venue_policy).

away_goals_rule_active.description: True if the away-goals rule applies (historical, era-aware).

extra_time.description: True if extra time is played (for knockout stages).

penalties.description: True if penalties decide when extra time is insufficient.

seeding.description: How entrants are seeded into this stage.
